issues.name: Account access and management problems
issues.description: People report trouble deleting or changing accounts, recovering access, and securing compromised accounts.

issues.name: App access failures
issues.description: The app may fail to open or work, log people out, or prevent them from getting back in.

issues.name: Login failures
issues.description: People are unable to log in, including when using a phone number or trying to access an existing account.

issues.name: Unexpected or incorrect charges
issues.description: Customers report unwanted, repeated, or incorrect charges, as well as difficulty canceling subscriptions or getting paid features activated.

issues.name: Basic features require payment
issues.description: People feel that too many basic app features are restricted to paid plans and that the free experience is inadequate.

issues.name: Features restricted to Premium
issues.description: Specific listening and playback features, including lyrics and repeat, are unavailable or limited without Premium.

issues.name: Pressure to get Premium
issues.description: People feel pushed toward Premium because ads and limits make the free experience difficult to use.

issues.name: Premium is too expensive
issues.description: Customers consider Premium prices too high or no longer worthwhile.

issues.name: Subscription limitations and upselling
issues.description: People object to subscription restrictions, unwanted upselling, or subscription periods that do not last as expected.

issues.name: Missing or mismatched catalog content
issues.description: People report unavailable songs or content, missing album tracks, and recommendations or results that do not match their chosen language.

issues.name: Lyrics missing or not loading
issues.description: Lyrics are missing, fail to load, or have stopped appearing in the app.

issues.name: Podcast availability and discovery issues
issues.description: People report inaccessible podcast shows and unwanted podcast suggestions or placement in the app.

issues.name: Unwanted or repetitive recommendations
issues.description: Recommendations may be irrelevant, repetitive, or replace music people intended to hear.

issues.name: Search problems
issues.description: Search may fail to find or play the intended song, show connection errors, or lead to a blank page.

issues.name: Downloads fail or disappear
issues.description: Downloads may not work, disappear unexpectedly, or be lost from playlists and albums.

issues.name: Downloaded music unavailable offline
issues.description: Downloaded content may not play or remain available without an internet connection.

issues.name: General dissatisfaction
issues.description: These reviews express broad dissatisfaction with Spotify or its updates without identifying a specific app problem.

issues.name: App crashes during use
issues.description: The app crashes unexpectedly, including during song changes, playlist selection, or when changing playback settings.

issues.name: Playback problems with car and Bluetooth
issues.description: People report trouble connecting or playing through car and Bluetooth devices, including playback that gets stuck.

issues.name: Music stops or plays incorrectly
issues.description: Music may stop unexpectedly, restart, report a false offline status, or fail to play the intended song.

issues.name: Podcast playback interruptions
issues.description: Podcasts may stop, hang, fail to play, or buffer unexpectedly, including downloaded episodes.

issues.name: Unresponsive or unhelpful support
issues.description: People report receiving no response or poor assistance when seeking help with Spotify problems.

issues.name: Too many advertisements
issues.description: People find the volume or repetition of advertisements disruptive, including during podcasts.

issues.name: Playback starts automatically on devices
issues.description: Spotify starts playing automatically when devices connect or the app opens, and people struggle to stop it.

issues.name: General usability complaints
issues.description: These reviews describe broad annoyances with the app, including advertising, without a consistent specific usability issue.

issues.name: Playback controls behave unexpectedly
issues.description: People report missing or unreliable playback controls, including previous track, shuffle, and Smart Shuffle options.

issues.name: Playlist management and navigation issues
issues.description: People report frustrating playlist controls, unwanted added songs, lost position, and difficulty navigating playlists.

issues.name: Unwelcome changes after updates
issues.description: People dislike update-related changes to layout and familiar playback or song preview features.
